observations.body: God’s kindness and mercy are joined to washing, renewal by the Holy Spirit, rich outpouring through Jesus Christ, justification, hope, and inheritance.
observations.label: The Spirit is said to be poured richly through Jesus Christ

observations.body: The passage presents Saving, renewing, pouring, justifying, and inheriting as the scene's observable response or movement.
observations.label: Saving, renewing, pouring, justifying, and inheriting

observations.body: The passage places God our Savior and Jesus Christ beside Saving, renewing, pouring, justifying, and inheriting.
observations.label: God our Savior and Jesus Christ

payload.posture: Read Titus 3:4–7 as one movement in Pentecost, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states god’s kindness and mercy are joined to washing, renewal by the Holy Spirit, rich outpouring through Jesus Christ, justification, hope, and inheritance. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Pentecost.
payload.title: The Spirit is said to be poured richly through Jesus Christ
